title: Qwan'tez Stiggers appears to be OK after he was stretchered off Jets' practice field

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Qwan'tez Stiggers appears to be OK after he was stretchered off Jets' practice field
sources.description: Jets cornerback Qwan'tez Stiggers had to be taken off the field on a stretcher today, but after practice, Jets coach Aaron Glenn suggested that Stiggers is going to be OK.
